sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the approved-analysis-or-formula alternative, formula operands and expected-result tolerance, load-case radius and weakest-direction evidence, units and datatypes, and the conditional blade-failure-status check while preserving the prior instruction not to require status unconditionally.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not require nltl:bladeFailureStatus unconditionally: the source states a conditional failure classification and does not independently require a status value when bladeTipOffset is at or below 0.10 times propellerDiameter. Remove its top-level sh:minCount 1 while retaining datatype validation for any supplied value.
